hooks.command: /bin/sh -lc 'set -a; [ -f "$HOME/.codex/menagerie.env" ] && . "$HOME/.codex/menagerie.env"; repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); [ -f "$repo/.codex/menagerie.env" ] && . "$repo/.codex/menagerie.env"; set +a; [ -n "$MENAGERIE_HOME" ] || { echo "MENAGERIE_HOME is not set" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$MENAGERIE_HOME/bin/codex-menagerie-hook"'
